★★★★★

I was on holiday in Albania, in Vlore, when I came down with a severe stomach infection and needed medical assistance. I contacted my insurance company PZU, and within about two hours they processed my case and contacted Medical Vranes

A doctor from the clinic came to see me exactly when arranged, just 30 minutes later. The next day, they sent me to their partner laboratory in Albania, where I was seen without any waiting. The test results were ready within a few hours, and on the following day another doctor from the clinic came to see me again

Everything was handled very quickly, clearly and professionally. The team was friendly and helpful throughout the whole process

Excellent service and highly recommended!

Excellent medical care; we were met with great understanding right from the moment we arrived, and the nurses and staff were friendly and empathetic. The consultation went smoothly, and all recommendations were clearly explained to us :)
Sve je bilo brzo, profesionalno i organizovano. Osoblje ljubazno, a sve što nam je bilo potrebno završili smo bez čekanja i komplikacija. Sve preporuke!
Sve pohvale za profesionalnost i brzinu usluge! Doktorka Jelena nam je došla u smeštaj da pregleda bebu i prepiše terapiju!

We visited the clinic with my daughter while travelling, and being sick in another country is always very stressful. It took us a little time to find the entrance, but everything else was smooth. We were seen quickly, the doctor examined her thoroughly, listened to all our concerns, and provided clear, effective recommendations so we could safely recover without needing hospitalization. Thank you very much for your care and support!
Sve preporuke. Brzi, pouzdani, rešili su nam sve brzo.

Ми зверталися (в серпні 2026) з хворим хлопчиком (по страховці). Лікар, яка нас оглядала - виявилася чудовим спеціалістом і чуйною людиною. Вона призначила сину необхідне лікування, виписала рецепт на ліки і разом з нами прийшла до аптеки та допомогла їх нам придбати.
Ми залишилися прийомом лікаря повністю задоволені і дуже вдячні!
Дуже рекомендуємо цей медичний заклад!

Podczas pobytu za granicą zachorowałam zatoki kaszel i ból uchu Bardzo szybko została mi udzielona pomoc ze strony lekarza który przyjechał z osobą która mówiła i rozumiała w języku polskim co spowodowało ze wizyta dość szybko byla zrealizowana w sposób rzetelny Zalecenia zostały mi wyjaśnione oraz przetłumaczone przez translator by upewnić sie czy wszystko zrozumiałam Bylam bardzo zaskoczona udzieloną mi pomocą w tak szybkim czasie
